findings.title: Stored XSS via unescaped embed URL
findings.body: In app/models/topic_embed.rb the import method interpolates the raw url into HTML: "#{url}". The url comes from user-supplied embed_url (via EmbedController/RetrieveTopic) or from RSS feed fields, and only path/query is attacker-controlled even when the host matches. A single quote in the path breaks out of the href attribute and injects arbitrary markup/JS, which is then stored as raw_html and rendered with raw in the embed view. Escape/sanitize the URL before interpolation.

findings.title: Unsanitized raw_html rendered with raw
findings.body: In app/views/embed/best.html.erb the template outputs <%= raw post.cooked %>. Combined with the new Post.cook_methods[:raw_html] path, cooked is arbitrary remote HTML from RSS/Readability stored verbatim without cooking or sanitization. Any compromised feed or fetched page yields persistent JavaScript execution in the embed iframe and in any other place the post is displayed.

findings.title: Reflected XSS via request.referer in postMessage targetOrigin
findings.body: In app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb request.referer, which is fully attacker-controlled, is interpolated directly into a JavaScript single-quoted string: parent.postMessage(..., '<%= request.referer %>'). A referer containing ' can break out and execute script. Additionally the full referer URL including path is used as targetOrigin instead of scheme://host:port, so legitimate messages fail origin checks.

findings.title: Inverted/insufficient postMessage origin check
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/embed.js the handler does if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) return;. This tests whether discourseUrl contains e.origin instead of whether e.origin equals discourseUrl. Short/substring origins pass, and legitimate origins with different formatting may fail. An attacker iframe/window can send discourse-resize messages that resize the embed. Require strict equality against the expected origin.

findings.title: Wrong default for cook_method makes all posts raw_html
findings.body: In db/migrate/20131219203905_add_cook_method_to_posts.rb the column is added with default: 1, null: false. Post.cook_methods is Enum.new(:regular, :raw_html), so regular is 0 and raw_html is 1. Every existing and future post without an explicit value becomes raw_html, so Post#cook returns raw uncooked HTML instead of cooked output, breaking rendering and bypassing sanitization site-wide. Default should be the regular value.

findings.title: Unvalidated open(url) allows SSRF/LFI and DoS
findings.body: In app/models/topic_embed.rb import_remote does open(url).read with no scheme validation, timeout, size limit, or rescue. It is reachable from TopicRetriever with user-supplied embed_url, from PollFeed with feed item links, and from the disqus importer. open-uri follows redirects, so internal hosts/metadata endpoints can be fetched, local file wrappers or pipe metacharacters may be abused depending on Ruby version, large bodies exhaust memory, and network errors raise unhandled exceptions that fail jobs.

findings.title: Feed fetch without error handling, timeout, or nil guards
findings.body: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb the job does SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) with no begin/rescue, timeout, or size cap, so any network/DNS/parse failure crashes the scheduled job. Below it calls i.content.scrub without checking for nil content/title, causing NoMethodError on feeds missing those fields. The defined feed_key for conditional polling is never used, so the full feed is refetched every hour.

findings.title: raw_html cook path skips sanitization pipeline
findings.body: In app/models/post.rb Post#cook returns raw verbatim when cook_method is raw_html, skipping PrettyText cooking and sanitization. Since TopicEmbed creates/updates posts with skip_validations and this cook method from remote content, malicious HTML/JS is preserved and later served as cooked, enabling stored XSS wherever the post excerpt or body is shown outside the embed iframe.

findings.title: Invalid X-Frame-Options value
findings.body: In app/controllers/embed_controller.rb ensure_embeddable sets response.headers['X-Frame-Options'] = "ALLOWALL". ALLOWALL is not a valid X-Frame-Options directive; browsers treat unknown values as DENY or ignore framing inconsistently, which can break legitimate embeds. To allow framing, the header should be removed or ALLOW-FROM with the specific origin should be used where supported.

findings.title: Non-atomic throttle key and unbounded URL key
findings.body: In lib/topic_retriever.rb retrieved_recently? uses $redis.setnx followed by separate expire, which is not atomic. If the process crashes between calls the key never expires and that URL is throttled forever. The key is "retrieved:#{@embed_url}" with raw user input, so an attacker varying query strings creates unlimited keys and unlimited RetrieveTopic jobs, bypassing the per-URL 60s throttle and enabling Sidekiq/network flooding.
